description: Golden-baseline corpus for the folio-mapper -> folio-resolve migration (SCHEDULE.md row 3). Synthetic only: NO customer taxonomies. Exercises every deterministic seam the migration retires — the word-order-invariant scorer, the stopword set, the legal-term expansions, the branch-signal words, and the search-term generator. Categories: exact, word_order, expansion, specificity, subphrase, stopword_only, place, homonym, compound, abbreviation, nonsense.
